adoption.rationale: The pinned server requires an authenticated GitHub delivery and validates repository.full_name before emitting an action token. The shell helper repeats owner/repository checks before cache invalidation or process_pr; the existing source tests exercise the action dispatcher. This contract claims a local protocol guard, not a demonstrated remote vulnerability.

declared_domain: Exact Aidevops pin 8666b6c6c52472b5535aa295f2df593918152cb1; ASCII repository.full_name strings received through the authenticated local action pipe; no NUL is representable in the pipe line and the server emits a single protocol token. The property covers the full _webhook_valid_slug helper, including patterns at lines 197 and 198 and the explicit . and .. name checks.
guarantee: Before webhook-derived repository text reaches a collection invalidator, check-cache invalidator, or process_pr dispatch, the receiver accepts only one slash-separated repository token whose owner starts with an ASCII letter or digit and whose name is neither . nor ... Both components use only the source helper’s ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, and hyphen alphabet; this keeps the action line unambiguous.
input_source: The repository.full_name field in a GitHub webhook payload. The pinned Python server verifies the raw-body HMAC and validates the field before emitting local action records; the shell receiver applies this additional guard before dispatch and cache invalidation.
